item.title: Getting Started
item.description: New to Swing Catalyst? Start here for system requirements, installation guides, and an overview of the platform. Frequently Asked Questions This is an overview of the most frequently asked questions. Getting Started - Swing Catalyst Home This article is the getting started guide for the Swing Catalyst Home. How to install & uninstall Swing Catalyst This support article describes how to install or uninstall Swing Catalyst*. How to install or change your license key

item.title: Cameras & Video
item.description: Everything about setting up and using cameras with Swing Catalyst, from supported models to network configuration and troubleshooting. Camera Setup Network configuration, lighting, and general camera setup guides. Camera Models Model-specific guides for FLIR, IDS, Basler, Fox, and Lynx cameras. Troubleshooting Fix dropped frames, upgrade issues, and other camera problems.

item.title: Hardware
item.description: Set up and configure hardware devices that integrate with Swing Catalyst, including pressure plates, launch monitors, and diagnostics tools. Pressure Plates Install, calibrate, and configure balance plates and BodiTrak sensors. Launch Monitors Connect FlightScope, Foresight, Trackman, and other launch monitors. Diagnostics & Setup Calibration diagnostics, force plate troubleshooting, and hardware setup.

item.title: Software & Features
item.description: Learn how to use Swing Catalyst’s software features, from recording and exporting sessions to motion capture analysis and data visualization. Recording & Export Record lessons, export videos, and share sessions with students and coaches. Motion Capture Set up and use motion capture for 3D body tracking and swing analysis. Data & Analysis Understand force vectors, key metrics, graphs, and data visualization tools. Setup & Configuration Configure keyboard shortcuts, feedback screens, and application settings.

item.title: Account & Setup
item.description: Manage your Swing Catalyst account, subscription, installation, backups, and system configuration. Billing & Subscriptions Manage your Swing Catalyst subscription, payments, and account billing. Installation & Setup Install, update, and configure Swing Catalyst on your system. Backup & Database Back up, copy, move, and manage your Swing Catalyst database and settings. System & Diagnostics Check system specs, collect logs, and optimize your computer for Swing Catalyst.
